name: Sharda Cropchem Ltd

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 gross margin 37.3% (+750bp) and FY27 guidance of 10-15% revenue growth with 18-20% EBITDA margin; FX and price-led gains flatter the base, and management sidestepped the ex-FX margin question.
